sources.summary: Arquitectura en Corto invites you to Espacio Arquia in Madrid (16 Tutor St.) on Thursday, September 17, at 7:00 PM for the screening of the short film Amarar . The title refers to a traditional Mallorcan technique for treating wood by immersing it in water to increase its durability.
